# WebsiteBench

> WebsiteBench is a benchmark of 70 production-level websites that AI agents rebuild through browser exploration. An agent explores a reference site in a browser and builds a full-stack offline version, scored by 46,916 hidden tests. Eight models were evaluated with a 16-hour limit per run. The best, Claude Opus 5.5, has a 26.2% pass rate.

## Pages
- [Leaderboard and citation](https://website-bench.com/index.md): the eight models, benchmark design, FAQ and BibTeX
- [Run](https://website-bench.com/run/index.md): commands to run the benchmark with Harbor
- [Tasks](https://website-bench.com/tasks/index.md): the 70 websites, each with every model's result
- [Eval](https://website-bench.com/eval/index.md): how a rebuild is evaluated, with one real run
- [Analysis](https://website-bench.com/analysis/index.md): why agents fall short

## Read by id
- Any page as Markdown: `curl -sL https://website-bench.com/<kind>/<id>/index.md`, for example [Amazon](https://website-bench.com/task/amazon/index.md) for `curl -sL https://website-bench.com/task/amazon/index.md`
- [Agent guide](https://website-bench.com/AGENTS.md): read commands, JSON data, citation and contact

## Leaderboard (percent of hidden tests passed: overall / Request / Browser / System)
- Claude Opus 5.5: 26.2 / 71.2 / 21.8 / 35.4
- GPT 6.1 Sol: 20.2 / 64.3 / 16.9 / 36.8
- Claude Opus 5: 17.1 / 58.8 / 12.9 / 28.8
- GLM 5.3 Flash: 14.7 / 43.3 / 11.4 / 24.8
- DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: 13.5 / 39.9 / 9.8 / 29.7
- Grok 4.6: 12.1 / 39.3 / 8.3 / 29.5
- Kimi K3: 10.6 / 41.0 / 6.8 / 25.6
- Qwen 3.8 Max: 7.3 / 28.7 / 4.1 / 21.8
